subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Bind code retirement to a unit-generation identity that changes when a unit disappears and returns inside a persistent file.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: Matching content and a stable file introduction cannot distinguish restored code from the generation the operator approved for retirement. FR-6 and UB-5 require retained history to make that transition visible.
fit_criterion: The identical-unit same-file removal, restoration, and second-deletion fixture refuses old authority in every validation mode.
